Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese!🍗🍯🧀 Absolutely one of the best combos, so indulgent, bursting with flavour and packed with 60g of protein! Macros Per Serving (4 Total) 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat Ingredients (Makes 4) Honey Garlic Chicken - 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Black Pepper - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) - 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder - 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika - 2 Tsp Olive Oil - 30g Light Butter (Brand: Lurpak) for cooking + extra once cooked - 2 Tsp Minced Garlic - 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) - Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside Garlic Mac n Cheese - Big Tbsp Minced Garlic - 300ml Skimmed Milk - 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) - 1 Tsp Salt or to taste - 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper - 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) - 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) - 220g Uncooked Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter of the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then Serve & ENJOY! . . . . #garlicbutter #honeygarlic #chicken #chickenrecipes #macncheese #macaroni #pasta #macandcheese #highprotein #mealprep #foodie #healthyrecipes #weightloss #lowcalorie #eathealthy #fitness #mealprepideas

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. Simmer uncovered 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has completely reduced and the beef is moist but not watery. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Remove from heat and cool slightly. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and cook 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy. Continue cooking until all sides are crisp and the cheese is melted. Rest 1–2 minutes, slice in half and serve immediately with extra cheeseburger sauce.  #recipe #cheeseburger

videos.caption: Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Warm up sauce in a pan, serve on a wrap with fresh lettuce and enjoy . . . . #garlicparmesan #chickenwrap #chickenrecipes #highprotein #healthyrecipes

🤖 THREEHALVES — THE CENTAUR ROBOT Threehalves is a 7-foot-tall teleoperated robot developed by Satyress. Its design combines a human-like torso and arms with a powerful four-legged chassis, creating a mechanical centaur built for environments that are too dangerous for humans. The idea behind Threehalves is simple: instead of sending a person into extreme heat, unstable terrain, darkness, hazardous industrial environments or disaster zones, a skilled operator can control the robot remotely and perform the work from a safer location. Unlike many humanoid robots, Threehalves is designed around tools and equipment that humans already use. Its modular limbs and quick-connect system allow it to be adapted for different tasks, while its four-legged platform provides stability on difficult terrain. The most unsettling part is probably its appearance. With its enormous size, humanoid body, four mechanical legs and distinctive horned head, Threehalves looks less like a traditional industrial machine and more like something from a science-fiction horror movie. But behind the terrifying design is a serious engineering concept: putting the machine in danger instead of the human. Threehalves is still a developing robotics project, but it represents a strange glimpse into a future where dangerous jobs could be performed remotely — with a human controlling the machine from a distance. And honestly… it might be one of the creepiest robots ever built. 👁️ #threehalves #robot #baal #satyress #horrortok

Crockpot Mongolian Beef & Noodles 🥩🍜🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 7: Mongolian Beef & Noodles This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you’ve got. Tender chuck roast, a sweet and savory Mongolian-style sauce, and noodles coated in all that flavor. We sear the beef for extra color, then the crockpot does the work and you take the credit! 🙌🏽🔥 Ingredients: 2 pounds thinly sliced chuck roast 4 tablespoons butter, for searing 1 cup low-sodium shoyu 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup low-sodium beef broth 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 tablespoon grated ginger 2 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons cold water 12 ounces precooked lo mein noodles. I used yakisoba noodles brand is Fortune. Sliced green onions Sesame seeds, optional Instructions: 1. Season your beef with SPG or your favorite seasoning. Heat a skillet over high heat with the butter and sear the beef in small batches for 1-2 minutes per side. You’re building color, not cooking it through. 2. Transfer the beef to the crockpot. Deglaze the skillet with a splash of the measured beef broth, scrape up those browned bits, and pour everything into the crockpot. 3. Add the remaining broth, shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and black pepper. Stir gently. 4. Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or HIGH for 2.5 to 3.5 hours. Start checking early so the thin beef stays tender without falling apart. 5. Mix the cornstarch slurry with a cup of broth. Stir the slurry into the sauce and cook on HIGH for 15–20 minutes, until thick and glossy. 6. Slice the green onions into 1 inch piece. Separate the precooked noodles and add them directly to the crockpot. Toss everything together and heat on HIGH for 5–10 minutes. 7. Finish with sliced green onions, sesame seeds, and chili crisp oil if you want some heat then serve immediately. Don’t leave those noodles sitting on KEEP WARM—they’ll keep drinking up the sauce. Save this one for an easy weeknight dinner! 🍜🔥 #crockpotrecipes #crockpot #EasyRecipe #hawaiitiktok #mongolianbeef

Day 19 | 20 Days of 20 Minute Summer Dinners 😋 Simple deliciousness at its finest! To save time you can prep the 2nd half of the recipe as the chicken fries. Enjoy! Chris x CHICKEN FRANCESE | Serves 4 INGREDIENTS ➡️CHICKEN 2x 250g/9oz Chicken Breasts, close to room temp 35g / 1/4 cup Plain Flour 3/4 tsp Salt 1/2 tsp EACH: Black Pepper, Garlic Powder 2 Eggs 20g / 1/4 cup Parmesan (I use the refrigerated dusty stuff) 1 1/2 tbsp Olive Oil 1 tbsp/15g Unsalted Butter ➡️SAUCE 1 large Lemon, slice 4 thin rings from the centre then squeeze 1 tbsp juice from the ends 60ml / 1/4 cup Dry White Wine 180ml / 3/4 cup Chicken Stock 4 tbsp/60g Unsalted Butter, diced into small cubes (keep in the fridge until needed) 2 tbsp finely diced Fresh Chives METHOD 1️⃣Take two large shallow dishes. In the 1st combine the flour & seasoning and in the 2nd beat the egg & whisk in the parmesan. Lay two chicken breasts on a chopping board and horizontally slice them right through the centre to create 4 even-sized breasts. Individually coat each of them in the flour then return to the chopping board. 2️⃣Add 1 1/2 tbsp oil & 1 tbsp butter to a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Place the bowl with the egg next to the pan, then one by one coat the chicken in the egg, allow excess to drip off, then place in the pan. Cook each side for around 3mins, or until golden on the outside and just about cooked right through the centre. Remove the chicken from the pan and place on a plate to one side. Add the lemon slices to the pan and fry for around 20 secs each side, just until they start to soften & lightly colour. Remove from the pan (don't rest on the chicken). 3️⃣Pour in the wine and rapid simmer for around 2mins, or until it has mostly evaporated, deglazing the pan as needed. Pour in the stock and 1 tbsp lemon juice (you can adjust this later) and bring to a simmer. 4️⃣Add the cubed butter to the leftover flour then toss coat. Add the floured butter to the pan and swiftly whisk until it blends into the stock. Add the chives and continue simmering and stirring until the sauce turns cloudy and thickens slightly to a glossy texture. Generously season to taste. 5️⃣Add the chicken alongside any resting juices and place then lemon slices on top. Baste in the sauce to warm it back through then serve and enjoy.

One-Pan Dumpling Bake 🥟 I kept hearing this dumpling bake was one of the easiest dinners of all time, and it lives up to it. Everything goes into one pan, straight into the oven, and dinner’s done with almost no effort. It’s quick, affordable, and perfect for busy weeknights when you still want something really good. If you’re tired of eating the same boring meals every week, this is exactly why I share Weeknight Staples. Follow me to eat better and spend less. Ingredients •	1 can full-fat coconut milk (13.5 oz) •	2 tbsp red curry paste •	3 garlic cloves, minced •	2 tsp fresh ginger, minced •	3 tbsp soy sauce •	1 tbsp oyster sauce •	1 tbsp peanut butter •	1 tbsp sesame oil •	2 tsp rice vinegar •	Juice of 1 lime •	4 cups bok choy, chopped •	15–20 frozen dumplings (pork, chicken, or veggie) •	Optional toppings: chili crisp, green onions, sesame seeds, cilantro, lime Instructions 1.	Preheat oven to 400°F. 2.	In a 9×13 pan, whisk together the coconut milk, curry paste, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, oyster sauce, peanut butter, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. 3.	Squeeze in the lime juice. 4.	Stir in the chopped bok choy. 5.	Arrange the frozen dumplings on top in a single layer. 6.	Cover with foil and bake for 25–30 minutes until the dumplings are cooked through. 7.	Finish with chili crisp, green onions, sesame seeds, lime and cilantro if desired. Serve hot. #easydinner #easyrecipe #dumpling

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Arayes 🥙 This is one of the best Mediterranean meals you can easily make at home in about 30 minutes. Crispy pita stuffed with seasoned beef, cooked until golden, and finished with a creamy garlic sauce. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

If someone makes you this cake… they love you. Because this is a labor of love. 🤎🔥 For Black History Month, I’m bringing back Burnt Sugar Cake, a historic Black Southern celebration cake that slowly faded when box mixes took over. Burnt Sugar Cake Burnt Sugar Syrup • 1 cup granulated sugar (200 g) • 1 cup boiling water (240 ml) Melt sugar over medium heat until deep amber (do not stir, swirl pan). Carefully add boiling water, stir smooth, simmer 3–5 min. Cool. Reserve ½ cup for cake + ½ cup for frosting. Cake • 1 cup butter, softened (227 g) • 2 cups sugar (400 g) • 4 eggs • 3 cups cake flour (360 g) • 1 tbsp baking powder (14 g) • ½ tsp salt • 1 cup whole milk (240 ml) • ½ cup burnt sugar syrup • 2 tsp vanilla Heat oven to 350°F / 175°C. Grease three 8-inch pans. Cream butter + sugar 3–5 min. Add eggs one at a time. Whisk dry ingredients. Alternate dry ingredients + milk into batter. Mix in burnt sugar syrup + vanilla. Bake 25–30 min. Cool completely. Traditional Burnt Sugar Frosting (work fast!) • ½ cup butter (113 g) • 1 cup brown sugar (200 g) • ½ cup burnt sugar syrup • ¼ cup evaporated milk (60 ml) • 3–4 cups powdered sugar (360–480 g) • pinch salt + 1 tsp vanilla Boil butter, brown sugar, syrup & milk 2 minutes. Cool until warm, then beat in powdered sugar, salt & vanilla. Frost cake quickly before it sets. Optional Brown Sugar Penuche Frosting (creamier outside) • 1½ cups butter, divided (340 g) • 1½ cups brown sugar (300 g) • ½ cup heavy cream (120 ml) • 1 tsp salt • 4½ cups powdered sugar (540 g) Melt ¾ cup butter. Boil brown sugar + cream + salt. Beat into melted butter with powdered sugar. Add remaining butter 1 tbsp at a time. Rest 10–30 min until spreadable. Assemble Fill and frost cake with traditional burnt sugar frosting. Optional: cover outside with penuche frosting. Finish with rustic swoops and swirls. #BlackHistory #TikTokLearn#BlackHistoryBlackFoodHistory#TikTokLearningCampaigngeRecipes

Ingredients ½ cup shredded cheddar cheese, divided 2 large eggs, beaten Salt & black pepper, to taste 1 large flour tortilla ¼ cup cooked breakfast sausage, crumbled 2 slices cooked bacon, sliced Instructions Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Sprinkle half of the cheddar cheese directly onto the pan. Pour the beaten eggs over the cheese and season with salt and pepper. Immediately place the tortilla on top of the eggs. Gently press down and cook until the eggs are set. Flip everything over so the tortilla is on the bottom. Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese over one half of the tortilla. Top half quesadilla with cooked breakfast sausage and bacon. Fold to close the quesadilla. Cook for 1–2 minutes per side, flipping until both sides are golden and crispy and the cheese is melted. Had to try the viral Dirty Spaghetti and it did not disappoint!!! FULL RECIPE BELOW  1 lb ground beef 	•	1 lb ground Italian turkey sausage 	•	1 red bell pepper, diced 	•	1 green bell pepper, diced 	•	1 yellow onion, diced 	•	4–6 cloves garlic (or 1 tbsp garlic paste) 	•	2 tbsp tomato paste 	•	4 tbsp all-purpose flour 	•	3–4 cups beef broth 	•	16 oz spaghetti noodles 	•	½–1 cup pasta water (as needed) Seasonings 	•	1 tsp Nature’s seasoning 	•	1–2 tsp Cajun seasoning 	•	1 tsp Italian seasoning Instructions 	1.	Brown the meat In a large pot, cook the ground beef + turkey sausage over medium-high heat until browned. Drain excess grease if needed. 	2.	Build the flavor base Add onion and bell peppers. Cook 4–5 minutes until softened. Stir in garlic and cook for 1 minute. 	3.	Tomato paste + seasoning Add tomato paste and cook 2–3 minutes. Season with Nature’s, Cajun, and Italian seasoning. 	4.	Make it “dirty” (roux) Sprinkle in flour, stir well, and cook 1–2 minutes. 	5.	Create the sauce Slowly add beef broth while stirring. Let simmer until thickened. Choose Your Pasta Method Option 1: One-Pot (Original Way) 	6.	Add dry spaghetti directly into the pot (break in half if needed). 	7.	Cover and cook until tender, stirring occasionally. 	8. Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. Meals for Weight-loss:  Mexican Chicken Corn Salad Ingredients:  Chicken * Chicken breast, 800 g * Lime juice, 2 tbsp * Avocado oil, 1 tbsp * Chili powder, 2 tsp * Cumin, 1.5 tsp * Garlic powder, 1 tsp * Paprika, 1 tsp * Salt, 1 tsp * Black pepper, 0.5 tsp Veggies * Cotija cheese, 50 g * Red onion, 1 large, finely diced * Red bell pepper, 1 large, finely diced * Cilantro, 1 handful, chopped * Jalapeños, 3, finely diced * Canned corn, 2 cups total, drained and charred Sauce * Plain 0% Greek yogurt, 1 cup * Lime juice, from 0.5 lime * Hot sauce, 1 tbsp * Tajín, 1 tbsp * Water, 0.5 cup * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add it to a bowl with lime juice, avocado oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. 2. Heat a large pan on medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and fully cooked to 165°F. 3. Drain the canned corn really well and pat it dry with paper towel. In the same pan or a clean hot pan, add the corn in a single layer and let it sit untouched for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir and cook another 2 to 3 minutes until charred in spots. 4. In a bowl, mix Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt, and black pepper until smooth. 5. In a large bowl, add the charred corn, red onion, red bell pepper, cilantro, jalapeños, and cotija cheese. 6. Pour in the sauce and mix everything until coated. 7. Divide the chicken and street corn salad mixture into 4 servings. Store chilled and eat within 3 to 4 days. Just to clarify, this video was never meant to be racist in any way. I was speaking purely from an artistic perspective. As I'm starting to learn coloring, I naturally find some skin tones more challenging to render than others. That doesn't mean I like them any less. In fact, both my mom's and my dad's sides of the family are Black. My mom herself has dark skin, so why would I dislike the same skin tone as my own family? The same goes for hair textures. I have naturally curly/coily hair, and from an artistic point of view, I personally find it more difficult to draw and render than straight hair. That doesn't mean I don't like it—in fact, I love my hair. It's simply about the technical challenge of drawing and coloring different features, nothing more. Please don't confuse artistic difficulty with personal preference or prejudice. They're two completely different things.  #dessin #black #fyp #drawing #fypシ゚

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

One Pan Cheesy Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Rice 😮‍💨 INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes  2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning   1 tbsp minced garlic BWW Parmesan Garlic Sauce  2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup white jasmine rice, rinsed   1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese  2 oz cream cheese 4 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  If you don’t have any bacon leftover from breakfast cook your bacon, drain the grease, and chop it into small pieces. Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

More than 2,000 humanoid robots were participating in the event, organisers said. In a 100-metre sprint, a humanoid robot achieved a result of 9.39 seconds, beating the human record of 9.58 seconds set by Jamaican athlete Bolt in 2009. In a standing high jump, a humanoid robot was able to reach 2.88m, well above the 0.95m best result by a humanoid in last year’s first edition of the games. It surpassed the human high jump record of 2.45m set by Cuba’s Javier Sotomayor in 1993. The five-day games, now in their second year, are a spectacle demonstrating China’s rapid progress in advanced robotics as the technology race with the US heats up. Recipes makes 6 servings: 1 serving is 477 calories, 57g protein 18 fat 16 carb Cheesy Buffalo Bacon Chicken and Potatoes Ingredients: * 3 medium russet potatoes * 32 oz. cubed raw skinless chicken * 1 cup Frank’s Red Hot Buffalo Sauce * 120g reduced fat cheddar cheese * 120g reduced fat mozzarella cheese * 14 slices center cut bacon * 60g 1/3 reduced fat cream cheese * Salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika Instructions: 1. Prepare the Potatoes:  * Wash and dice the russet potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 2. Air Fry the Potatoes:  * Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Place the seasoned potatoes in the air fryer basket and cook for 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden and crispy. 3. Cook the Bacon:  * In a large skillet, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove and drain on paper towels, then chop into small pieces. 4. Cook the Chicken:  * In the same skillet, remove excess bacon fat, leaving about 1 tablespoon. Add the cubed chicken and season with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and paprika. Cook until the chicken is browned and cooked through, about 7-10 minutes. (165 or higher internal temp) 5. Add Buffalo Sauce:  * Stir in the Frank’s Red Hot Buffalo Sauce and cream cheese into the cooked chicken. Mix until the cream cheese is fully combined and the sauce is thick. 6. in a large bowl combine your creamy buffalo chicken with your chopped bacon, 140g reduced fat cheese and stir in as it melts.  7. Evenly distribute your cooked potato and buffalo chicken into 6 containers. Refrigerate for 2-3 days or freeze and enjoy later.

New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt @nytcooking @zaynab_issa - 2 cups Greek yogurt - 2 mini cucumbers - 3 tbsp mint - 1 large garlic clove - 1 pound ground beef (80/20) - 1 small yellow onion - ½ tsp ground turmeric - 2 tsp salt - black pepper - ¼ cup walnut halves - 2 tbsp cranberries - Pomegranate molasses, optional, for serving - Warmed pita or white rice, for serving Combine the yogurt, cucumbers, chopped mint, and garlic in a medium bowl, mix well, and chill until ready to serve. In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot, then drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks, cooking undisturbed for 6 to 8 minutes until charred and crisp on the bottom. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Finally, season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, spread it across the bottom of a serving platter, layer the crispy meat on top, and finish with a drizzle of optional pomegranate molasses, fresh mint leaves, and a side of warmed pita or rice. #kabob #FoodTok #nyt #cooking #beef

Korean Popcorn Chicken 🍿🍗 For all of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store ‼️🫶 The crispiest korean porocrn chicken… sweet, spicy and so simple. You can also make this in the air fryer!!🔥 For the Chicken: -2 lb chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1 inch cubes -2 eggs -2 tbsp rice vinegar -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp gochugaru (optional) -1/4 cup cornstarch -1/2 cup all-purpose flour -Neutral oil, for frying For the Sauce: -1.5 tbsp gochujang -2 tsp sesame seeds -3 tbsp ketchup -4 garlic cloves, minced -1.5 tbsp honey -3 tbsp butter -1 tbsp rice vinegar -1 tbsp soy sauce -2 tsp sesame oil -1 tsp gochugaru (optional) Garnish: -Sesame seeds -Green onions, sliced Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine chicken with eggs, vinegar, garlic, ginger, & seasonings. Mix well & marinate as long as you wish (1 hour ideal, 1 min works). →For frying: add the cornstarch & flour directly into the same bowl and mix until evenly coated & sticky. →For air frying: do NOT add flour yet. You’ll coat it separately in step 2. 2. For frying: skip this step & go to step 3. For air frying: in a new bowl, mix cornstarch & flour. Remove chicken from marinade then toss in dry ingredients until fully coated. Press lightly so it sticks. 3. For frying: heat neutral oil to 350°F / 175°C. Fry in batches for 7–8 mins until golden and crispy, transfer to a rack. 4. For air frying: oil the basket & spray/brush the chicken with oil. Cook at 375°F for 8 mins, flip, cook for 6–8 mins more until crispy & cooked through. Work in batches. 5. In a pan over medium-low heat, combine gochujang, ketchup, sesame seeds, garlic, honey, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, & optional gochugaru. Bring to a simmer, add butter, stir until melted, remove from heat. 6. Add the chicken directly to the sauce & toss OR in a mixing bowl, combine your desired amount of sauce with the chicken to control how saucy it gets. 7. Serve over jasmine rice, garnish with sesame seeds & green onions. Enjoy :) #recipesoftiktok #chicken #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Here are three easy rotisserie chicken meals that are in my dinner rotation.  Just pick up a rotisserie chicken, or two, or three and make a meal prep out of it. I tried a new red enchilada sauce and it was seriously delicious. I was skeptical about the peanut butter, but then I was pleasantly surprised with how delicious it tasted. My entire family loved it!  Here are the recipes and instructions.  *Chicken Alfredo  3 tablespoons salted butter 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon onion powder 4 cups heavy cream 1 cup shredded Parmesan cheese 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper, plus more to taste 1 tbsp parsley leaves 16 oz penne pasta  3-4 cups shredded chicken  1 broccoli head, cut into bite sized pieces    1. Cook pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, stirring occasionally.  2. While the pasta cooks, in a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the garlic and onion powder and whisk for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Whisk in the cream and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and add the Parmesan. Whisk until the cheese is melted into the sauce, 1 to 2 minutes. Be careful not to let the sauce boil. Turn off the heat then season with salt and pepper. Add more if needed.  3. Add chicken, broccoli and pasta and toss until everything is coated.  Optional: add red pepper flakes for a little kick  *Chicken Noodle Soup  3 cups shredded chicken  3 Tbsp avocado oil  2 medium carrots,  sliced into thin circles 4 large sticks of celery, finely diced 1 small/medium onion, finely diced 8 cups chicken stock  4 cups water 4 medium potatoes,  peeled and cubed  2 bay leaves 2 Tbsp parsley 1 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 1/2 cups egg noodle pasta, or use 3/4 cup small pasta  1 garlic glove, minced  Directions: 1. In a large soup pot over medium- high heat, add 2 Tbsp olive oil. Once oil is hot, add onions, carrots, and celery and sauté until softened and golden, stirring frequently for 5-7 minutes.  2. Add broth, water, potatoes, bay leaf, 1 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Bring to a boil and continue cooking at a medium boil for 10 minutes 3. Add pasta and chicken and cook for 5 minutes or until pasta and potatoes are tender. Add more salt and pepper to taste. 4. Press in 1 garlic clove and stir in parsley then remove from heat and enjoy.  *Green Sauce Enchiladas  15-20 corn tortillas (you can make as many or little as you want)  28 ounce can of Las Palmas Green Chile Enchilada Sauce  Avocado oil (enough to cover the bottom of a pan)  1/4 of an onion, diced  2 tsp dried oregano  1 to 2 cups shredded chicken  3/4 tbsps white vinegar  Directions: 1. Add oil to a pan and heat on medium/low heat.  2. Take a stack of 5-10 tortillas, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for a minute. Just enough to soften so they don't break when handled.  3. Once oil is hot, add the tortillas one by one and allow them to lightly fry (2 to 3 seconds) then remove from oil and place them on paper towels to drain.  4. Heat sauce in a medium sized sauce pan on low and bring to a simmer. Remove and set aside. 5. Chop 1/4 cup onion and add about 3/4 tbsp of white vinegar and dried oregano. Mix to combine and set aside.  Assemble: To eat right away- -dip oiled tortillas into sauce. Add shredded chicken and about 1 tsp of the onion, oregano, vinegar mixture then roll up tightly and place in pan with the seam side down. Repeat process with the remaining tortillas.  When you plate them, top with shredded lettuce, queso fresco, and a few slices of avocado. You can also add sour cream and hot sauce. 😉 To freeze them and serve later- *prepare everything the same way but DO NOT add the sauce. Heat and add the sauce when you are ready to eat them.  *Red Sauce Enchiladas  Recipe in comments. Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Honey sriracha garlic  chicken tenders  Ingredients  For the chicken: 1 lb boneless chicken breast or chicken tenders, cut into small strips Salt to taste 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp white pepper  For the buttermilk batter 1 cup buttermilk 1 egg 3 tbsp hot sauce For the dry batter: 1 cup all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika 1/2 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp black pepper Salt to taste 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, optional Honey Sriracha Garlic Glaze 1/3 cup honey 2 tbsp sriracha sauce  1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tbsp butter 1 tbsp fresh garlic, finely minced 1/2 tsp smoked paprika 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, optional For the ranch dressing  1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/4 cup sour cream 2–3 tbsp buttermilk 1 tsp fresh lemon juice 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp dried dill 1/4 tsp dried parsley 1/4 tsp black pepper Salt to taste Method: Season chicken with salt, garlic powder, smoked paprika, onion powder, white pepper & black pepper. Toss well and let sit 15–20 minutes. Whisk together buttermilk, egg & hot sauce. In a separate bowl, whisk flour, cornstarch, baking powder & all dry coating seasonings. Dip chicken in buttermilk, then coat thoroughly in the dry coating. Dip back into buttermilk, then coat again. Press the final coating firmly onto the chicken for lots of textured, craggy pieces. Place on a wire rack and rest 5–10 minutes. Heat 3–4 inches of neutral oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches for 4–6 minutes, turning occasionally, until deeply golden and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack. For the glaze, add honey, sriracha, soy sauce, rice vinegar, minced garlic, smoked paprika & red pepper flakes to a saucepan. Simmer over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring frequently until smooth and glossy. Toss fried chicken in the honey sriracha garlic glaze right before serving. For the ranch, whisk together mayo, sour cream, buttermilk, lemon juice, garlic powder, onion powder, dill, parsley, black pepper & salt. #recipe #chickentenders #honeysrirachachicken

videos.caption: Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Cheesy Chipotle Chicken Rice Bowls Air Fryer Only Episode 2 Per Serving (Makes 5) 585 Cals 52g Protein 57g Carbs 17g Fat — Chipotle Chicken: 900g skinless chicken thighs (32oz) 5g avocado oil (1 tsp) 20g hot honey (1 Tbsp) Juice of 1/2 lime Season heavily: Chipotle or ancho chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, salt Fajita Veggies: 2 bell peppers 1/2 yellow onion 10g oil (2 tsp) 15g tomato paste (1 tbsp) Rice: 300g / 2 cups rice (dry weight) Or ~580g pre-cooked rice  Finishing Ingredients: 60g reduced fat mozzarella (1/2 cup) 60g extra sharp cheddar (1/2 cup) 100g 0% Greek yogurt (1/2 cup) Handful chopped cilantro Smokey Chipotle Sauce: 180g 0% Greek yogurt (3/4 cup) 60g milk (1/4 cup) 7g honey (1 tsp) 45g adobo sauce (3 Tbsp) Smoked paprika to taste Salt to taste - Instructions 1.) In a bowl, mix chicken thighs with avocado oil, hot honey, lime juice, and all seasonings. Toss until evenly coated. 2.) Cook chicken in an air fryer at 375°F for 20-25 mins, flipping halfway, until cooked through and lightly charred. Remove and chop into bite-sized pieces. 3.) Remove the air fryer rack. Add diced bell peppers, onion, oil, and tomato paste directly to the basket. Air fry at 350°F for 10–15 minutes, stirring once or twice, until softened and lightly browned. 4.) Add cooked rice directly to the veggies in the air fryer basket (or transfer to a large bowl). Stir in mozzarella, cheddar, and Greek yogurt until melted and creamy. Add chopped chicken and cilantro. Mix until evenly combined. 5.) Whisk together Greek yogurt, milk, honey, adobo sauce, salt and smoked paprika until smooth. 6.) Divide into 5 equal servings and top each with smoky chipotle sauce. Enjoy! #stealthhealth #airfryerrecipe #highproteinrecipe #highproteinairfryerrecipe #mealprep

We thought we’d try sharing meal prep early for next week so you can plan ahead! Let us know if this timing is better! CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Slice, toss + roast at 425°F for 20–25 min until tender + charred. QUICK TZATZIKI 2 cups Greek yogurt + 1 grated cucumber + 1 grated garlic clove + juice 1 lemon + ¼ cup dill + salt. Mix. Brush pita with olive oil + grill until lightly charred. Fill with tzatziki, beef kebab + roasted peppers and onions. MAPLE SWEET POTATOES 6 sweet potatoes, halved + a little olive oil + maple syrup. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P. 9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

The viral Brothy rice bowls are sooo savory and cozy and delish!! Made mine with a few extra veg too. Such a great dairy free dinner! Curry Broth * 3 cloves garlic, minced * 1 shallot, finely chopped * 3 tbsp red curry paste * 1 can light coconut milk * 1 cup chicken or beef broth * 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * Oil, for cooking Ground Beef & Vegetables * 1 lb ground beef * 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * 1 zucchini, sliced * 2 cups chopped spinach * Oil, if needed Serving * 2 cups cooked rice * Garnishes: Squeeze of lime, Chili crisp, Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Heat a drizzle of oil in a saucepan. Add garlic and shallot and sauté until fragrant. Add red curry paste and toast for 1 minute. Add coconut milk, broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. 2. Brown the ground beef in a skillet with 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce. Add sliced zucchini and cook until softened. Add chopped spinach and cook for a few more minutes until wilted. 3. Add rice to a bowl, top with the beef and vegetables, and pour the curry broth over everything. Garnish with lime, chili crisp, and sesame seeds.

 all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal
